normality_definition:
A box of pushpins consists of a transparent rectangular plastic box divided into a 3-row by 5-column grid of 15 individual compartments. Each compartment is fully enclosed by clear plastic dividers/separators on all four sides.

COMPONENTS:
- Pushpins: yellow/orange round-capped pins with a metal needle. All pushpins are the same color and size.
- Separators: transparent plastic walls forming the internal grid. All walls must be intact and clearly visible.

RULES (exact):
- Every compartment contains exactly one pushpin — no more, no less.
- No compartment is empty.
- No compartment contains two or more pushpins.
- All internal plastic dividers between adjacent compartments are present and clearly visible.
- The box forms a complete, uninterrupted grid with no missing walls between compartments.
